title: Field, Kellogg and Armour houses faced in red brick all round
items: 1905 (Marshall Field), 1923 (Kellogg) and 1945 (Armour/Corwith) Prairie no longer show buff or salmon common brick on their sides: every wall, bay and corner is now the same pressed red as the front.

Field's photographs show its conservatory side in the front's brick; Armour's Twentieth Street side faces a street. The other houses keep common brick on their sides, as the photographed flanks on the street show.
